text_block_list.text:
It was when I spoke on the phone with
Ines Fujin's mother after the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: "—'My girls... My two little sisters at home said they want to go watch the Arima Kinen.'"

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"I'm in the hospital, and I asked my husband to stay by her side.
We're truly sorry for being such pathetic parents, but..."

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"'...I want the three of them to meet face-to-face
and talk once more. Trainer, could I ask you
to help make that happen?'"

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for dragging you
into my family's affairs, Trainer."
choice_data_list: No, I'm just glad if I could be of help to her.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""...Thank you so much.
Please, take good care of my girls...!""
Ines Fujin's behavior up until now, and the flow of the conversation with her younger sisters.

Those sisters seem to have a misunderstanding.
Perhaps a third party being there could help
untangle the knots between them.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like the train
those two are on is arriving soon.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Big siiis~!
Trainer, nice to be working with you today too~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Ruu-chan, Suu-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I look forward to working with you.

A strained tension hung in the air between the sisters.
I took all three of them and headed
toward Nakayama Racecourse, the venue for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text: Waaah. It feels even more like a festival than when we came before!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's right, it's the Arima Kinen after all.
Let's hold hands tightly so we don't get separated, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Stop treating me like a little kid!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text: *zoooom!*

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
No way! I'm not listening
to you anymore, Big Sis!! ...Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Su-chan.
Because of my selfishness, I caused trouble for both of you, didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Big Sis will definitely
bring back our shared dream.
So that you can dance again with an easy heart...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: "...No, it's not! You dummy, Sis!!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Su-chan!? Wait, where are you going!?
Why are you so angry...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: Let's find her and hear her true feelings!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
P-Please let me through!
Um, I want to get to the front!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...That's Suu-chan's voice!

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text: Oh-ho. Did you come to watch Oguri's race too, squirt? You're lookin' all fired up, huh.

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
And she looks just like Ines!
So cute~ So, where's your mommy?
Are you lost by any chance~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me!!
That girl is my little sister, and—

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? For real!?
You're Ines's little sister!?

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
I mean, both sisters loving racing is crazy!
Is your future dream to be just like your big sis?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No. This child has a talent for dance.
So her dream is—

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: ...That's not true!!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
That's not true...!
My dream, my dream is...!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: "It's for Big Sis, who we cheered for with all our might, to take 1st place...!!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~, I get it. Watching Ines run
just fills you with energy, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Like, I love it so much
it literally changed my life~.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
"...Originally, I didn't know anything about racing.
My life was just part-time jobs, eating, and sleeping all day long~."

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
I don't really have goals or anything.
Part-time jobs suck, and so does life.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
"At that boring part-time job, though,
your sister worked super hard.
She was like, totally sparkling."

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
So you get curious and go watch her race, right?
And then Ines just runs like swoooosh, right?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Looking like they're having an absolute blast until the moment they drop.
Once you see that even once, man...

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
...I started thinking that maybe I should
give it everything I've got,
until I drop, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
...! Su thinks so too.
Watching big sis run gives me courage...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
That's why... Sue really, really loves
the way Big Sis runs...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Su-chan...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Both Lu and Su. The two of us should cheer
for Big Sis's run together. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Because my mind's already made up.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: Just like my big sister used to do for us before, we decided the two of us would take care of the house together from now on...

Fitting for a race featuring Oguri Cap, the Arima Kinen
was electric. But on the way back, Ines Fujin
stared blankly into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah. Umm...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Miss Oguri was so cool~!
But Lou wants to watch Big Sis's race next!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Ruu-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: ......Big sis.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: Keep running in lots of races. Seeing my big sister run a lot, smile a lot, and win lots of 1st places is...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: Because it's our whole family's dream right now...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Suu-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...A dream.
choice_data_list: It's my dream, and their dream too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Running was always supposed to be my own selfish desire, yet...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Su-chan, Lu-chan.
Can your big sister ask you for a favor?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Can the two of you help out at home right now?
So that Big Sis can run in races here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Can I count on you two?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I'll do it! I'll do it!!
Then Big Sis will—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm gonna run a ton.
In all kinds of races. And have lots of fun.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thank you... both of you.

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yeah!!
choice_data_list: Let's keep running alongside everyone's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Right, Trainer...!
The crimson sunlight shines upon Ines Fujin and the others. Gently, warmly... as if embracing Nakayama Racecourse, where the most dreams crossed paths today.
